source.title: ESIMGG快捷选号网更新记录（新手碎碎念）

policy: Preserve dated community outcomes and conflicts as evidence; do not convert them into provider guarantees.

observations.claim: Community participants described a France unlimited-data path as available/free at the time, with approximately 128Kbps throttled service.
New registrations were reported at USD1; a user reported the first 1GB at high speed followed by approximately 128Kbps.
One eUICC/small-card user reported no signal while another SE3 user still had service and later measured approximately 0.01Mbps.
A user reported continued no-signal and said many profiles, including some USD1 paid activations, had been closed.
A later commenter reported that an order could no longer be created.

mechanics: first 1GB high speed then approximately 128Kbps reported
notes: Community outcomes conflict across devices; preserve the conflict rather than generalizing a universal failure state.
This snapshot adds dated direct-user detail to the earlier USIMS free-mechanism and later price-delta evidence.
